comment: A cytochrome P450 monooxygenase, AmyB is responsible for the atropospecific formation of one carbon-carbon and two carbon-nitrogen bonds on precursor peptide

reactions.description: AmyB introduces atropospecific one carbon-carbon and two carbon-nitrogen bonds
AmyB introduces one C-C and two C-N bonds on the precursor peptide followed by maturation by protease yielding hexapeptide amyxirubin A (AWYIWW) and pentapeptide amyxirubin B (WYIWW)
